purpose: Teach: 大将/造っ/初戦/日立/造形/フラワー/チューブ/ムリ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お寿司屋さんの大将、最近、新メニュー、出してるよ、行こうよ。
lines.en: Aoi, that sushi master has been putting out some new dishes lately — we should go check it out.
lines.style: Bright, inviting opening. Light upbeat energy. Leans forward with genuine enthusiasm. The lift of someone sharing something good with a friend she wants to include.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。父が、若い頃、家を造ったって、聞いた、最近、話題に。
lines.en: Yeah, actually — I just heard recently that my dad built our house when he was younger. It's been on my mind.
lines.style: Quieter, more introspective. A small pause before the confession. Soft, almost surprised tone, like she's realizing she's been thinking about it. Gentle trailing into the last phrase.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 高校野球、初戦、見に行ったよ、私、彼と、応援に、行った。
lines.en: I went to see the first game of the high school baseball season the other day with my boyfriend — we went to cheer him on.
lines.style: Animated, energetic delivery. Quick pace on the setup. Brightens on the memory. A little proud. Natural conversational flow, not rushed despite the energy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 日立の家電、新しく、買ったの、性能、いいよ、私、満足。
lines.en: Actually, I bought a new Hitachi appliance recently and the performance is really good — I'm pretty satisfied with it.
lines.style: Warm, genuine approval. Medium pace. A small lift of satisfaction in the voice. Grounded, not over-performing. Like she's genuinely pleased with a practical choice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 美術館、現代造形作家の展示、面白かったよ、葵、行ってみて。
lines.en: The contemporary sculpture exhibit at the museum was really interesting — you should go see it sometime, Aoi.
lines.style: Eager, encouraging without pressure. Brightness on the recommendation. Genuine desire to share something good. Open, inviting tone that respects Aoi's choice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店内、フラワーアレンジメント、新しく、変えたよ、季節感、出るね。
lines.en: I changed the flower arrangement in the shop — put in some seasonal pieces. It really brings out that time-of-year feeling.
lines.style: Soft, satisfied. Quiet pride in a small, careful choice. Gentle pacing. The contentment of someone who notices and tends to beautiful details.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 絵の具のチューブ、たくさん使う趣味、結構お金、かかるよね、絵画。
lines.en: I go through a lot of paint tubes with my hobby — painting can get pretty expensive, honestly.
lines.style: Wry, self-aware tone. A small laugh underneath. Rueful but not complaining. Self-deprecating ease. The tone of someone who sees the absurdity of her own passion.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ムリしないで、葵としても、心配だよ、メイちゃん、最近、忙しいよね。
lines.en: Just don't push yourself too hard, okay? I worry about you — you've seemed pretty busy lately, Mei.
lines.style: Tender, close concern. Quieter than before. Softer attack. The voice of someone who has been watching, who cares enough to say it gently. Eye contact level. No lecturing, just care.
